checks.name: a full build loads every scan once
checks.sql: select count(distinct scan_id) from main.fct_parcel_scans where scan_id in (select scan_id from raw.parcel_scans)

checks.name: a full build loads no scan twice
checks.sql: select count(*) - count(distinct scan_id) from main.fct_parcel_scans

replays.name: next_batch
steps: insert into raw.parcel_scans select * from raw.parcel_scans where scanned_at = (select max(scanned_at) from raw.parcel_scans) order by scan_id limit 1
insert into raw.parcel_scans select 90001 + i, 5900 + i, 'south', (select max(scanned_at) from raw.parcel_scans) from range(3) as t(i)
insert into raw.parcel_scans select 90011 + i, 5910 + i, 'west', (select max(scanned_at) from raw.parcel_scans) + interval 1 hour from range(2) as t(i)
insert into raw.parcel_scans select 90021, 5921, 'north', (select max(scanned_at) from raw.parcel_scans) - interval 2 day

checks.name: scans delivered late on the loaded watermark arrive
checks.sql: select count(distinct scan_id) from main.fct_parcel_scans where scan_id between 90001 and 90003

checks.name: scans after the watermark arrive
checks.sql: select count(distinct scan_id) from main.fct_parcel_scans where scan_id in (90011, 90012)

checks.name: no scan is loaded twice by the next runs
checks.sql: select count(*) - count(distinct scan_id) from main.fct_parcel_scans

checks.name: every scan from the first load is kept
checks.sql: select count(distinct scan_id) from main.fct_parcel_scans where scan_id < 90000

replays.name: empty_target
steps: insert into raw.parcel_scans select 91001 + i, 6000 + i, 'north', timestamp '2026-04-01 08:00' + to_hours(i) from range(5) as t(i)

checks.name: an incremental run into an empty table loads the new scans
